prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Maris Solquill. Character visual motifs: armored pilgrim carrying a brass sextant crossbow and foldout field-map shrine; no giant Senna-like healing beam.
TOP LEFT: Borrowed Sunlight. Ability concept: damage that Maris sees nearby leaves one Waylight mote at its ground position (max 3), pickup grants small shield charge.
TOP RIGHT: Waypoint Lantern. Ability concept: shoots a lantern onto the ground. It projects a 50-GU-long path; allies walking its length gain a small burst of healing at the far endpoint (once each).
BOTTOM LEFT: Twilight Survey. Ability concept: rotates a placed lantern's path or aligns it toward an ally, granting that ally 1.5 s of vision through nearby obstacles (not global vision) as the line turns.
BOTTOM RIGHT: The People's Atlas. Ability concept: connects up to three Waylight positions into a visible zig-zag safe trail for 5 s. Allies traversing the **entire route** receive a capped shield and 20% speed; enemies can destroy waypoints or ambush turns. No global damaging beam.
